senses.gloss: kā-usaggiyā (HA), Sanskrit kāyotsargikā; the image of a Tīrthaṅkara standing in the kāy-otsarga posture. See kā-ussagga.
kā-ussagga (HA), Sanskrit kāy-otsarga (q. v.); a posture of meditation in which one stands erect with arms hanging and the soles of the feet kept four inches apart.
